title: Building Gunship game that runs on web browser and mobile
author: Gomsoup
selftext:
I’m currently building a gunship game that runs on web browser and mobile. You can play on desktop too. I’ve added different types and class of enemies and added zombie themed missions too. There’s also a feature to create your own map but I personally haven’t used it and I unusually use random mission generator instead.

It’s rough around edges and I’m looking for more ideas to make gameplay feel more immersive and engaging and feedbacks around where it falls short.

You can try at: **gunship-deathfromabove.vercel.app**
